Appendix B. S-band radar equipment on large ships
This appendix gives the technical parameters of the S-band navigation radars that large ships carry, for use in the EMC
B.1 Two kinds of transmitter
S-band ship radars use one of two transmitters, and the two differ by more than a factor of 100 in peak power:
Magnetron radars transmit short, high-power pulses on one frequency that the magnetron sets, anywhere within a tolerance
Solid-state radars transmit at less than 1% of a magnetron's peak power. They make up for it with long pulses of 4.6 µs
No public source gives the share of ships fitted with each kind. ITU-R M.1460-1 (2006) describes magnetron radars only.
